namespace_correction.diagnosis: Current syscall PID namespace differs from the mounted ancestor procfs view; raw numeric /proc paths and ancestor PGIDs are not actionable identities.
namespace_correction.mapping: Require exact active PID namespace inode, then use matched NSpid/NSpgid/NSsid terminal components for syscalls; retain ancestor/proc path/start-tick evidence separately.
namespace_correction.ownership: Current UID plus per-launch nonce and exact run marker across matching live session/group members; arbitrary event PIDs are not signal authority.
namespace_correction.ambiguous_or_unreadable_mapping: Preserve typed HOLD/warnings; no ancestor-PID fallback or unverified unrelated-process kill.
